claude.result:
I've successfully implemented weekly subscriptions for subtrack. Here's what was changed:

## Summary of Changes

✅ **Weekly subscription support** — Added `--every week` option to `subtrack add`
- Weekly plans cost: price × 52 ÷ 12 per month (accounting for 52 weeks/year, 12 months/year)
- Example: €59.90/week = €259.57/month
- Weekly plans charge every 7 days from their `--since` date
- `subtrack renewals` shows weekly charges alongside monthly and yearly plans

✅ **Fixed monthly cost rounding** — Costs are now rounded to the nearest cent instead of truncated
- Example: €119.99/year now shows €10.00/month (was €9.99/month)
- Applied to all subscription types

✅ **Fixed renewals sorting** — Changed from sorting by human-readable label to actual date order
- Ensures upcoming charges display chronologically, regardless of month

All 35 tests pass, including new tests for:
- Weekly plan cost calculations
- Weekly charge dates (every 7 days)

Would you like me to commit these changes?
